lookup: Vertex index lives in TEXCOORD_1.x as (index + 0.5) / vertices. Frame row r is stored bottom-up: with THREE.TextureLoader (flipY = true, the default) sample v = (r + 0.5) / frames. Use NearestFilter, no mipmaps.
decode: position = boundsMin + rgb * (boundsMax - boundsMin) in the NPC object frame (Z up, faces +Y). Flat-shade with dFdx/dFdy. Blend between adjacent rows for smooth playback.
variants: Per-instance variant 0..5: if uv.y is inside the variant block (v 0.25..0.5, u 0..0.375) add variant * 0.0625 to uv.x.
